Case note: A.S. No. 113/2021
Client: Harpreet Rathore (software engineer, Kolkata)
Opposing party: Iyer Marine Ltd
Court: Calcutta High Court, before Justice Sudhir Dhingra
Filed on: 21 September 2021
Claim amount: Rs. 14,03,00,000
Issue: maritime salvage claim. The vessel is about to leave port.
Advice given: Arrest the vessel to secure the salvage claim.
Outcome: The vessel was arrested until security was furnished.
Recommended next step: Negotiate the salvage award.
Matter code: Project Ibis
